description: This file defines the EmailService class responsible for handling email operations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for configuring email transport, sending emails, template selection, and queuing email notifications, as well as utility functions for validation and logging.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: A service class responsible for sending, queuing, and managing email notifications, including handling email templates and configurations.

methods.name: getEmailDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailDao, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailQueueService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailQueueService, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Gets the configured sendmail path.

methods.name: setSendmailPath
methods.description: Sets the sendmail path.

methods.name: isConfigSet
methods.description: Checks if email configuration is set and valid.

methods.name: setConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the configuration status flag.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current EmailConfiguration object.

methods.name: setMessageSubject
methods.description: Sets the email message subject.

methods.name: setMessageFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender addresses.

methods.name: setMessageTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient addresses.

methods.name: setMessageBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the email.

methods.name: setMessageCc
methods.description: Sets CC recipient addresses.

methods.name: setMessageBcc
methods.description: Sets BCC recipient addresses.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads email configuration from the database and system settings.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Sets the email configuration object.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailConfigurationService.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Creates or returns the current Mailer instance based on configuration.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Creates the appropriate MailTransport object based on current email configuration.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MailMessage object based on set properties.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends the email if configuration and recipient addresses are valid, logs the outcome.

methods.name: sendTestEmail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify email configuration.

methods.name: validateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates a single email address.

methods.name: areRecipientAddressesValid
methods.description: Validates multiple recipient email addresses.

methods.name: queueEmailNotifications
methods.description: Queues email notifications for multiple recipient roles based on an event.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateBestMatch
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate email template based on locale, recipient, and performer roles.

methods.name: queueEmailNotification
methods.description: Queues a single email notification based on template matching and event data.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of an email template file, path resolved relative to plugins directory.
